The best time to visit Vanuatu is during the **dry season from May to October** , when the weather is warm, sunny, and much less humid.[[1]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)[[2]](https://www.traveloka.com/en-au/explore/destination/the-best-time-to-visit-vanuatu-what-to-expect-each-season-acc/1010769)

### Season Breakdown

- **Dry Season (May – October):** 
	- **Weather:** Cooler and drier, with average temperatures ranging from 21°C to 27°C and low humidity.
	- **Best for:** Hiking, mountain and volcano treks (such as Mount Yasur on Tanna), scuba diving (like the SS President Coolidge off Espiritu Santo), surfing, and general island-hopping.
	- **Key Events:** The traditional *naghol* land diving ceremony on Pentecost Island runs from April to June, the Toka Festival takes place in August, and Fest'Napuan is held in October.
	- **Tip:** This is peak tourist season, particularly during Australian school holidays (such as July), so booking flights and accommodation early is recommended.[[1]](https://www.myvanuatu.com.au/blog/the-best-time-to-visit-vanuatu/)[[2]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)[[3]](https://www.traveloka.com/en-au/explore/destination/the-best-time-to-visit-vanuatu-what-to-expect-each-season-acc/1010769)[[4]](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/guide-to-vanuatu)[[5]](https://www.flightcentre.com.au/holidays/vu/travel-guide)
- **Shoulder Seasons (May to early June and September to November):** 
	- **Weather:** Pleasant transition periods with manageable crowds and good weather.
	- **Best for:** Snagging travel deals, enjoying quieter blue holes and rainforests, and avoiding peak-season crowds while still catching good conditions.[[1]](https://www.virginaustralia.com/au/en/destinations/vanuatu/best-times-to-visit-vanuatu/)
- **Wet / Hot Season (November – April):** 
	- **Weather:** Hot, tropical, and humid (averaging 28°C+), with higher rainfall and lush, green landscapes.
	- **Cyclone Risk:** This period overlaps with the South Pacific cyclone season (running from November through April, with peak risk in January and February).
	- **Best for:** Budget travelers looking for lower prices and fewer tourists, though you should expect short heavy downpours and potential minor disruptions to domestic flights or boat transfers.[[1]](https://www.traveloka.com/en-au/explore/destination/the-best-time-to-visit-vanuatu-what-to-expect-each-season-acc/1010769)[[2]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)[[3]](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/things-to-know/travel-tips/weather)

You can check active updates and travel tips through the official [Vanuatu Tourism Office](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/things-to-know/travel-tips/weather).[[1]](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/things-to-know/travel-tips/weather)If you share your **preferred month of travel** and **what activities** you are most excited about (like diving, culture, or hiking), I can help tailor a rough itinerary for you.
